name: Life spaceship 9f474023 on 3-uniform tiling k3-055
description: A period-64 spaceship in Conway's Life (B3/S23) on the 3-uniform tiling k3-055, with touching neighbours, 28 to 84 cells, moving 16 lattice steps every 64 generations (c/4).
